name: 天照经过灼烧
description: 棋子实际经过天照地格或传送落在该格时，按接触格数附加天照；同次接触不重复计算。
skillCode: if (battle.extensions && battle.extensions.amaterasuOwnerPlayerId && context.playerId !== battle.extensions.amaterasuOwnerPlayerId) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (!battle.extensions || !battle.extensions.amaterasuCells || battle.extensions.amaterasuCells.length === 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; var movedPiece = context.sourcePiece; if (!movedPiece || movedPiece.currentHp <= 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; var pathCells = Array.isArray(context.contactCells) ? context.contactCells : []; var sourceCell; var amaterasuHit = 0; pathCells.forEach(function(cell) { var hit = battle.extensions.amaterasuCells.find(function(c) { return c.x === cell.x && c.y === cell.y; }); if (hit) { sourceCell = sourceCell || hit; amaterasuHit++; } }); if (amaterasuHit === 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; var tag = movedPiece.statusTags && movedPiece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'amaterasu-burn'; }); var newStacks; if (tag) { tag.stacks = (tag.stacks || 1) + amaterasuHit; newStacks = tag.stacks; } else { addStatusEffectById(movedPiece.instanceId, { id: 'amaterasu-burn-' + movedPiece.instanceId, name: '天照灼烧', type: 'amaterasu-burn', sourcePieceId: sourceCell && sourceCell.sourcePieceId, currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 2, stacks: amaterasuHit }); newStacks = amaterasuHit; } return { success: true, message: movedPiece.name + '经过天照范围，附加' + amaterasuHit + '层天照效果（当前' + newStacks + '层）' };
